services.title: Special Purpose Machines
services.short: Special purpose machines are built for one specific operation or product rather than general use.
services.tagline: Built for one operation. Built to do it perfectly.
services.intro: Special purpose machines are built for one specific operation or product rather than general use. They deliver high speed, repeatability and a low cost per part for dedicated production — designed around your component and your cycle time.
applications: Drilling, tapping, boring and milling of automotive and engineering parts
Press-fit, riveting, marking and cutting operations
Dedicated production lines for high-volume parts

services.title: Automation & Robotics
services.short: Robotic cells and automated assembly lines raise output, repeatability and worker safety — from robotic body welding and assembly to EV battery pack lines.
services.intro: Robotic cells and automated assembly lines raise output, repeatability and worker safety — from robotic body welding and assembly to EV battery pack lines. We supply them as custom automation solutions that fit your production process.

EV battery pack and electronics assembly
Machine tending for CNC and press lines

services.title: Conveyors
services.short: Conveyor systems move materials and finished goods through a plant with little manual handling.
services.tagline: Material in motion, with little manual handling.
services.intro: Conveyor systems move materials and finished goods through a plant with little manual handling. Our range includes roller, belt and slat conveyors in straight, curved and inclined layouts.
applications: Heavy-duty transfer in steel, automotive and engineering plants

services.title: Dies & Press Tools
services.short: Dies and press tools shape sheet metal into precise components in high-volume production.
services.tagline: Sheet metal, shaped precisely — at volume.
services.intro: Dies and press tools shape sheet metal into precise components in high-volume production. Progressive dies, blanking and piercing dies, and die sets with guide pillars, springs and punches — built for accuracy and long tool life.

Blanking, piercing, bending, forming and drawing operations

services.title: Hydraulic Systems

services.title: Industrial Fabrication
services.short: Industrial fabrication covers the cutting, welding and assembly of structural steel into frames, skids and plant structures — heavy base frames, long welded beams, trusses and multi-level process plant structures.
services.intro: Industrial fabrication covers the cutting, welding and assembly of structural steel into frames, skids and plant structures — heavy base frames, long welded beams, trusses and multi-level process plant structures. Quality welding and accurate dimensions come first.

Structural steel for plants and warehouses
Process plant platforms, staircases and towers

services.title: Jigs & Fixtures
services.short: Jigs and fixtures hold and position parts accurately so each one is machined, welded or inspected the same way — manual toggle-clamp, pneumatic and modular fixtures on precision base plates.
services.tagline: Every part held the same way, every time.
services.intro: Jigs and fixtures hold and position parts accurately so each one is machined, welded or inspected the same way — manual toggle-clamp, pneumatic and modular fixtures on precision base plates. They improve repeatability, shorten cycle times and reduce rework.
applications: Welding fixtures for automotive and fabricated assemblies

services.title: New Product Development
services.short: New product development takes an idea from design to a working prototype, and then to production — 3D CAD modelling alongside the matching machined component.
services.tagline: From idea to prototype to production.
services.intro: New product development takes an idea from design to a working prototype, and then to production — 3D CAD modelling alongside the matching machined component. A design-led process reduces risk before tooling and manufacturing begin.

services.title: Power Transmission

services.intro: Power transmission components move torque and motion between machine parts — spur, helical and bevel gears, shafts, racks, pulleys and bearings. We produce them to your drawings and specifications.

services.intro: Precision machined parts are made on CNC machines to tight tolerances and a high surface finish — shafts, flanges, valve and manifold blocks, housings and fittings in steel, stainless steel, aluminium and brass.
